notes.content: Lower Division Activity Breadth Course Requirement

Students must complete 5 courses from at least 5 of the 7 groups listed below (5-10 units): Aquatics Dance, Tumbling, or Gymnastics Individual or Dual Outdoor Education/Recreation Personal Defense or Combatives Team Sports Weight Training or Fitness
notes.contentHtml:
Students must complete 5 courses from at least 5 of the 7 groups listed below (5-10 units):

  • Aquatics
  • Dance, Tumbling, or Gymnastics
  • Individual or Dual
  • Outdoor Education/Recreation
  • Personal Defense or Combatives
  • Team Sports
  • Weight Training or Fitness

notes.content: Students must select 1 of 2 advising patterns for completion of the major course requirements. The 2 advising patterns are: Coaching and Administration Pattern, and Fitness and Wellness Pattern. Both patterns list KINE 247 (see below) as an elective course students may choose. The required courses and remaining elective courses for both patterns are at the upper division level. See the University Catalog for a full listing of the degree requirements.
